$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/product.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office writes the product master data through apps/factory-api's modules/product, always through command(); the API keeps staff to the companies their grants reach. The floor (factory_floor_runtime) reads what it works from: materials and their colours, sizes, styles, colourways, SKUs, revisions, BOMs and routings, the operation library. No product table has a site key, so a floor device reads its whole tenant's product data (styles are tenant- or company-wide; the work order brings the site). The floor never reads a cost, margin or price column (plan A1 §2.2, §2.6: the column grants leave out every `@grain cost|margin|price` column; src/product.pg.vitest.test.ts checks every such column of this file and compliance.json), nor the made-to-measure templates. Portal and link sessions read nothing here. No role deletes: master data is archived (status ARCHIVED), a revision is obsoleted; a released revision and its BOM lines, size quantities, colour cells and routing operations never change (the …_product_guards triggers, for every login). After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Colour.about: The office keeps the colour library. The floor reads it (colour names on screens and travellers).

Item.about: The office keeps the material library: units, sourcing, tracking, default supplier, standard cost, leather and compliance attributes. The floor reads materials to pick, issue and cut them, never the standard cost.

ItemColour.about: The office keeps each material's colours with the supplier's colour codes. The floor reads them (the right colour picked and cut).

SizeScale.about: The office keeps the size scales. The floor reads them.

Size.about: The office keeps each scale's sizes, their order and body measures. The floor reads them (size buttons, garment labels).

Style.about: The office creates, edits and archives styles: code, name, product type, brand, size range, PPE classification, made-to-measure. The floor reads them (the style on every work order, label and scan screen).

Colourway.about: The office keeps a style's colourways. The floor reads them.

Variant.about: The office builds the colour x size SKU matrix and switches cells on and off. The floor reads SKUs and barcodes (labels, scans, packing).

StyleRevision.about: The office opens a draft revision, edits it, releases it and obsoletes it; a released revision changes no more (triggers). The floor reads revisions (the work order's specification).

BomLine.about: The office edits a draft revision's BOM. The floor reads it (what to pick, issue and cut); a BOM line has no cost column: costs come from the item, behind the floor's column grant.

BomLineSize.about: The office types a draft revision's quantities per size. The floor reads them (leather area per size at cutting).

BomLineColour.about: The office fills a draft revision's colourway colour grid. The floor reads it (which material colour each colourway takes).

Operation.about: The office keeps the operation library with standard minutes. The floor reads it (operation names and instructions).

RoutingOperation.about: The office edits a draft revision's routing. The floor reads it: the operations it scans, with their standard minutes.

MeasurementTemplate.about: The office keeps the made-to-measure templates per garment type and measures riders with them. The floor reads none: a made-to-measure work order carries the rider's frozen measurements.

MeasurementPoint.about: The office keeps each template's points of measure, units and plausible ranges.
